type O = { f(n: number): number; c: number; arr: number[]; g(): O };

function getArray(): number[] | undefined {
  return undefined;
}
function getFunction(): ((n: number) => void) | undefined {
  return undefined;
}

let index: number;
getArray()?.[(index = 0)];
console.log(index);

let argument: number;
getFunction()?.((argument = 1));
console.log(argument);

function laterLink(a: O | undefined) {
  let x: number;
  a?.g().f((x = 1));
  return x;
}
function laterIndex(a: O | undefined) {
  let x: number;
  a?.arr[(x = 1)];
  return x;
}
function nonNullable(a: O) {
  let x: number;
  a?.f((x = 1));
  return x;
}
function comparedChain(a: O | undefined) {
  let x: number;
  if (a?.f((x = 1)) === 1) return x;
  return 0;
}
function narrowedAfterward(a: O | undefined) {
  return a?.f(a.c) ?? a.c;
}
